_comment: Body catalog — canonical physics at the game scale (radius = real_km x10, mu = real/5190, soi = real_SOI_km x10, moon orbit x10, heliocentric orbit = AU x 40e6; SOL special-cased). Levels reference bodies by name; the loader assigns the role (a level's root gets soi=INF and no parent). Phase is a per-level scenario param, not stored here.
